diagnosis: The DeleteStoredCard Echo handler operates under a global JWT middleware that verifies the caller is authenticated. However, the handler deletes the stored payment method specified by the cardID URL parameter without verifying that the card belongs to the user identity encoded in the JWT claims. An authenticated customer can delete credit cards and payment methods belonging to other customers.
